map.基于Lund-Mackay评分系统，评估慢性鼻窦炎CT影像严重程度，每侧鼻窦浑浊: Based on the Lund-Mackay scoring system, it grades the severity of chronic rhinosinusitis on CT, scoring each sinus's opacification from 0 to 2 and the ostiomeatal complex 0 or 2.
map.Lund-Mackay 鼻窦 CT 评分 = 左右侧各 6 个鼻窦 / 窦口复合: The Lund-Mackay sinus CT score is the sum of 6 sinuses or ostiomeatal complexes on each side (0 to 2 each: none, partial or complete), out of 24; up to 4 is mild, up to 12 moderate, up to 20 severe and above 20 extremely severe.
map.黏膜病变轻微，可考虑保守治疗: Mild mucosal disease, conservative treatment can be considered
map.多窦受累，药物治疗后评估手术指征: Several sinuses involved; assess surgical indications after drug treatment
map.全组鼻窦受累，强烈建议手术: All sinus groups involved, surgery strongly recommended
map.每个鼻窦（上颌窦、前组筛窦、后组筛窦、蝶窦、额窦）根据浑浊程度评0-2分（0=正: Each sinus (maxillary, anterior ethmoid, posterior ethmoid, sphenoid and frontal) is scored 0-2 by its degree of opacification, where 0 is normal, 1 partial and 2 complete; the ostiomeatal complex (OMC) scores 0 or 2, where 0 is not obstructed and 2 completely obstructed. Each side is worth up to 12 points and the total is up to 24.
map.慢性鼻窦炎术前阅 CT，按 Lund-Mackay 量化双侧鼻窦病变范围。: Reviewing CT before chronic rhinosinusitis surgery and quantifying the extent of bilateral sinus disease with Lund-Mackay.
map.鼻窦手术后复查 CT，对比总分变化评估疗效。: Reviewing CT after sinus surgery and comparing the total score to assess the outcome.
map.多组鼻窦受累判断手术指征（总分≥13 多建议手术）。: Judging surgical indications when several sinus groups are involved, with a total of 13 or above usually calling for surgery.
map.右侧上颌窦2+前筛2+后筛1+蝶窦1+额窦0+OMC2=8；左侧同=8；总分16: Right: maxillary 2 + anterior ethmoid 2 + posterior ethmoid 1 + sphenoid 1 + frontal 0 + OMC 2 = 8; the left is the same at 8; the total of 16 out of 24 is severe, so endoscopic sinus surgery is recommended.
map.OMC 为什么只评 0 或 2 分？: Why does the OMC only score 0 or 2?
map.窦口鼻道复合体为关键引流通道，仅判是否阻塞（0 未阻塞 / 2 完全阻塞），不细: The ostiomeatal complex is the key drainage pathway, so only obstruction is judged (0 not obstructed, 2 completely obstructed) without distinguishing partial obstruction.
map.评分与 Lund-Kennedy 内镜评分如何配合？: How does it combine with the Lund-Kennedy endoscopy score?
map.Lund-Mackay 反映 CT 解剖病变，Lund-Kennedy 反映内镜: Lund-Mackay reflects CT anatomical disease and Lund-Kennedy reflects endoscopic mucosal inflammation; together they assess chronic rhinosinusitis more comprehensively.
map.基于Lund-Mackay评分系统，对慢性鼻窦炎鼻窦CT影像进行量化评估，是鼻窦: Based on the Lund-Mackay scoring system, it quantifies sinus CT findings in chronic rhinosinusitis and is a standardised tool for preoperative assessment and postoperative follow-up.
map.左右侧各6个部位独立评分: Independent scoring of 6 sites on each side
map.自动计算总分和左右侧分: Automatic calculation of the total and of each side
map.鼻窦CT影像量化分析: Quantitative analysis of sinus CT images
